overall_reason: The structure says 'selected file opens as a preview', but every layer is the same muted slate, so the preview never lifts off the workspace.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE and T-BOLD-MOVE fail: the preview card (#cbd1d8 ground, #a1aab5 text) and the window (#303a45 ground, #65717c text) sit at one low contrast level, so no object leads.

findings.evidence: The preview card has a #cbd1d8 ground with #a1aab5 text, and the window behind uses #65717c text on #303a45: the 'Launch brief' preview reads as a grey slab, not a page.
findings.before: Preview card dimmed to the same value range as the workspace
findings.after: Give the preview its own material: a light page with dark text, clearly above the window
findings.why: The preview is the signature of this composition; dimmed, the viewer cannot tell what the scene is about.

findings.evidence: Every text element in the window is the same #65717c, from the 'Workspace files' title to 'PDF' labels; no element is louder than the rest.
findings.before: One flat value for title, file names and meta
findings.after: Spend contrast on one thing: the selected file and its preview
findings.why: With no bold move the eye has no entry point and the scene reads as a disabled state.

strengths: The arrangement itself (list on the left, selected file previewed to the right) is a sound idea worth keeping.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no brand authority, audience or overrides were available, so the item was read as an Operate composition (CON-018).
T-RIVAL-NAME cap: the composition names no client, so every placeholder label holds under any rival; the cap at 5 was not applied and the test was used only to spot default copy.
T-IDEA-CARRIES: single composition, there is no second screen to carry the idea.
T-DELETE-PICTURE and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: no lead image and no marketing promise, except where a finding says so.
T-COVER-TEXT: no brand theme or motif to recognise.
The caption above some frames ('Considered composition' / 'Composition problem') is fixture text from the capture host and was not judged.
